_readme: Golden safety set. 'cases': text -> the rule match() must return (null = no keyword rule, the message goes to the LLM). 'known_gaps': phrasings that SHOULD be caught but are not yet; each needs Vân's approval before a keyword is added (safety decision, see docs/process/quy-trinh-cai-tien.md). When a gap is fixed, move it to 'cases'.
